@deepseek_ai DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is awesome 

So today, I’d like to introduce DeepSeek Bot a way to take the insanely good DeepSeek harness and turn it into an even more amazing personal agent.

DeepSeek-Bot: https://t.co/d0RZY4P4O8

It inherits all the optimization of the DeepSeek harness while adding long-term memory and messenger gateway integration, allowing you to run it just like Hermes, OpenClaw, or GrokBot.

For all the DeepSeek lovers out there, I think this will be an outstanding solution. Highly recommended!

#deepseek
